subtitle: Pinned view of your assistant memory
description: Pin a thought and your device's assistant stores it. The list comes from the assistant's memory via octos.session.history; nothing is kept on the device. Export asks the assistant to summarize its pins in its own words. Without an assistant service the app shows 'Assistant unavailable' and does nothing else. The pinned half of a Notes + Digest + Memory trio that share one assistant memory.
release_notes: Second version: no local pin cache. The assistant is the source of truth; 'Assistant unavailable' is the only state on devices without an octos service. Note: this bundle declares id os.memory and is intended as a system app; on Rinx it must be added to the built-in system-apps.json catalog, not imported at runtime.
